meta_description: P.G Electricals is a trusted local electrician in Newcastle. We handle rewiring, fault finding, testing and installations. Call 07973 905289 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault on a Sunday in Whickham? We fix wiring, test circuits, and install safely—same-day call-outs available.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full rewiring projects, we handle domestic and light commercial electrical work across Tyne & Wear.

services.title: Emergency Call-Outs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped switches, power cuts—we respond quickly to get your electrics working again. Available 24/7 for urgent faults.

services.title: Rewiring & Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We strip and rewire to modern standards, including consumer unit upgrades and earthing improvements.

services.title: Testing & Inspection
services.desc: EICR testing for landlords and home buyers. We identify hidden faults before they become dangerous, with a detailed compliance certificate.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: New sockets, USB outlets, dimmer switches, and smart lighting fitted safely and neatly. Improves convenience and adds value to your home.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repair
services.desc: Intermittent trips, flickering lights, or dead circuits? We diagnose the cause and fix it properly, not just patch it over.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Wiring
services.desc: Full electrical installation and wiring for new boilers, immersion heaters, and heating controls. Safe, compliant, and tested.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Newcastle families an electrician they could actually trust.
about_para_1: P.G Electricals was founded on the principle that electrical work should be reliable, fairly priced, and done right the first time. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, diagnosing faults properly, and never overcharging. We serve homeowners and small businesses across Newcastle and Whickham with the same care every time.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we explain what's wrong, tell you the cost upfront, and finish the job to a standard we'd be happy with in our own homes. Whether it's a simple socket replacement or a full rewire, you'll get someone who knows their trade and respects your time.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About P.G Electricals

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a tripped electrics board on Christmas Eve. Rang P.G Electricals in a panic and they were at the house within 45 minutes. Found a dodgy socket behind the kitchen units, sorted it in no time, and the charge was fair. Brilliant service—will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Getting a survey done for our house purchase in Gateshead and the surveyor flagged up old wiring. Called P.G and they came out the next day for an inspection. No pressure, no upselling—just a clear report and honest advice. Fixed the issues straightaway. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Catherine H.

reviews.text: Needed two new lighting circuits and some socket work before we moved in. Fair quote, turned up on the morning they said they would, and did a proper clean job. Everything tested and certified. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone in Newcastle.
reviews.author: James P.
